card.title: REICH RESEARCH
card.text: Choose one - add V-1 FLYING BOMB to hand OR add EXPANDED REICH R&D to hand.
card.flavorText: At the start of WWII Germany had a leading edge in industrialized and technological warfare. At the start of the war they had also been researching nuclear energy for the war effort, but in 1941, they decided to abandon its nuclear program and focus on the development of other new technologies that had a more immediate impact. This included the Sturmgewehr 44, the first mass produced assault rifle, the V-1 flying bomb, the Me 262 and the Arado 234 jet engined aircraft, but with all these it was a case of “too little, too late” and didn’t really affect the outcome of the war. Furthermore, as the war prolonged chemistry research and development became vital as Germany became increasingly isolated from raw materials during WWII. Chemists started developing techniques for producing synthetic alternatives to rubber and petrol and Chemical expertise was required to set up and run factories for these products.
